name: Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser
description: The Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser, alternatively the Maxima-A class heavy cruiser or simply the Maxima-A cruiser, was a wedge-shaped First Order heavy cruiser deployed around thirty years after the Battle of Endor. New Republic Commander Poe Dameron discovered two of the cruisers at a staging point as the Cold War heated up.

data.name: Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser
complement: At least 18 squadron TIE/fo space superiority fighters
